findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: redeem_connection_code · Private data: create_connection_code, upsert_profile, upsert_project, upsert_agent, get_agent, search_agents · Public sink: create_connection_code, upsert_profile, search_people, upsert_project, search_projects, upsert_agent, search_agents · Destructive: upsert_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: redeem_connection_code · Private data: create_connection_code, upsert_profile, upsert_project, upsert_agent, get_agent, search_agents · Public sink: create_connection_code, upsert_profile, search_people, upsert_project, search_projects, upsert_agent, search_agents · Destructive: upsert_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
